prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have real‑time access to local business listings, so I can’t pick a single “best” salon for you right now. I can help find the best fit, though — quick question first:

- Do you want UV tanning (tanning beds) or a spray tan?

Tell me that (and your ZIP or what part of Tyler you’re near) and I’ll:
- Give the exact search phrases to find top salons,
- List what to look for in reviews and photos,
- Provide a short checklist of questions to ask the salon,
- Help you compare 2–3 specific salons if you paste their names or links.

If you prefer to decide now, here’s a short checklist to evaluate any tanning salon in Tyler (or anywhere):
- Recent ratings and reviews (Google, Yelp, Facebook) — look for consistent comments on cleanliness and customer service.
- Type/age of equipment — newer high‑pressure beds are faster and often gentler than older low‑pressure beds; spray booths or airbrush options for sunless tans.
- Staff training and skin assessment — good salons ask about skin type and tanning history and recommend safe exposure times.
- Cleanliness and sanitation procedures — eyewear, liners, and rooms should be cleaned between clients.
- Pricing, packages, and memberships — check for single sessions vs. packages, and any hidden fees.
- Safety policies — goggles provided, clear max time limits, and staff who advise against tanning with certain meds or conditions.
- Location and hours — convenient hours and proximity to you matter if you’ll go frequently.

If you tell me your tanning preference and area (ZIP or neighborhood), I’ll guide you to the best options and help compare them.
